title: Review the squash-chain landing design independently
summary: Write an independent critical review of docs/design/squash-chain-landing.md. Check it against the gate code, the tests, and docs/decisions.md. Deliver it as a new docs file with findings and a verdict, without changing code.

defaults_applied.how: Each finding cites file and section or code evidence.
The review is written for an outside reader.
One new doc, no code changes.
The output location and format were inferred from the docs/design convention.

assumptions: 'Independently' means a fresh critical review that does not rely on the design author's own conclusions, written as a document rather than as code changes.
The review is delivered as a new docs file, not as edits to the design doc itself.
question: Should the review be a new docs file, or only a report in the chat? I assumed a new file at docs/design/squash-chain-landing-review.md.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new review document exists at docs/design/squash-chain-landing-review.md, written for an outside reader.

The review reads docs/design/squash-chain-landing.md and cites specific sections, plus the related code (crates/athena-gate/src/jobs.rs, invariant.rs, landing_tests.rs) and docs/decisions.md entries, for each finding.
Each finding has a severity, the evidence, and a recommended change. The review ends with an overall verdict (approve, approve with changes, or reject).
The review checks whether the design's claims match what landing_tests.rs and the code actually do, and lists gaps such as untested failure modes.
No existing file other than the new review (and optionally a link from docs/design) is modified. No code, config, or records change.
Run `git status` and `git diff`: only docs files changed. Run `cargo test` to confirm nothing broke.

out_of_scope: Changing the landing code or tests
Changes to governance files or records
departures: The output form (a review document) is uncertain, so acceptance is slightly lower than the reference.
